description:
Schedule a message to be posted at a future time.

post_at is a Unix timestamp in SECONDS (not ms). Max 30 scheduled messages per
channel per 5 minutes. Max 120 days in advance.

DIRECT MESSAGES: name the person, not the DM. Pass their Slack user ID (U…) or
email as channel; their DM is opened with the account that sends, so it cannot
reach anyone else. Find a user ID with lookup_user_by_email. A DM channel ID
(D…) on its own is refused, because it does not say who it is for; if you only
have one, add intended_recipient and it is used only if it is that person's DM.

channel.description: Where to send — channel ID (e.g., C1234567890), #channel-name (e.g., #general), or for a direct message the person's user ID (U…) or email

intended_recipient.description: Only with a DM channel ID (D…): the person (user ID or email) it should belong to. If it is not their DM, nothing is sent.

post_at.description: Unix timestamp IN SECONDS (not ms) for when to post

name: schedule_slack_message
